sets.relationshipLabel: category and a kind of fairground thing it includes
sets.explanation: An attraction can be bumper cars and a game can be ring toss — each pair names a broad category and one specific member of it.

sets.relationshipLabel: the thing that stops the event
sets.explanation: A safety bar exists to stop a fall and a fence exists to stop an escape — each device is defined by the outcome it necessarily blocks.

sets.relationshipLabel: an action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: To raise is undone by a strike, and to kindle is undone by a douse — each pair is an action paired with its exact reversal.

sets.relationshipLabel: thing and the feature it necessarily has
sets.explanation: A Ferris wheel always has a gondola and a carousel always has a carved animal — each ride is defined by a part it cannot lack.
